name: Systems Architect Examination
name_ja: システムアーキテクト試験 (SA)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, once yearly (April)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: National recognition and enterprise architecture depth support professional design responsibility at five years; partially security-focused scope does not establish expert security architecture on its own.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Enterprise architecture depth and a five-year profile support professional systems-design judgment. The paper exam and partly security-related scope provide less direct evidence for hands-on security architecture hiring.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded enterprise-architecture depth and five-year profile support professional design decisions. Security is only part of the assessment, so this does not demonstrate expert security architecture on its own.
